answer: SELECT ROUND(f."FRPM Count (K-12)"/f."Enrollment (K-12)",6) AS rate FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC='66' ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=t.cds WHERE t.rtype='S' AND t.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT s.City FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.CDSCode LIKE '%1611920113902' AND f."NSLP Provision Status"='Breakfast Provision 2' AND f."County Name"='Alameda' AND f."Low Grade"='9' AND f."High Grade"='12'

SELECT s.School, s.Phone FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON t.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC='03' AND t.rtype='S' AND t.NumGE1500=(SELECT MAX(t2.NumGE1500) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores t2 ON t2.cds=s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.DOC='03' AND t2.rtype='S')

SELECT g FROM (SELECT f."Low Grade" AS g, CASE f."Low Grade" WHEN 'P' THEN -1 WHEN 'K' THEN 0 WHEN 'Adult' THEN 99 ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) END AS r FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.NCESDist='0632640' AND f."Low Grade" IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY r LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(f."School Type",s.SOCType) AS school_type, s.School, s.Latitude FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND (f."School Type" IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)') OR (f."School Type" IS NULL AND s.SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)')) OR s.School LIKE '%Middle%') AND s.Latitude=(SELECT MAX(s2.Latitude) FROM schools s2 LEFT JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.CDSCode=s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND (f2."School Type" IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)') OR (f2."School Type" IS NULL AND s2.SOCType IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)','Junior High Schools (Public)')) OR s2.School LIKE '%Middle%'))

WITH c AS (SELECT s.School, s.District, s.County, t.AvgScrWrite w FROM satscores t JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=t.cds WHERE t.rtype='S' AND s.StatusType='Closed' AND t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL) SELECT School, District, County, w AS AvgScrWrite FROM c WHERE w=(SELECT MAX(w) FROM c WHERE w<(SELECT MAX(w) FROM c))

WITH cty AS (SELECT "County Name" n FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode LIKE '%1612590125716'), b AS (SELECT f.*, ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"*100,2) fp, ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"*100,2) pp, (SELECT t.AvgScrRead+t.AvgScrMath+t.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores t WHERE t.cds=f.CDSCode AND t.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND t.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL) sat FROM frpm f WHERE f."County Name"=(SELECT n FROM cty) AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)">500 AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)"<700) SELECT (SELECT n FROM cty) AS county, COUNT(*) AS num_schools, ROUND(AVG(fp),2) AS avg_free_pct, ROUND(AVG(pp),2) AS avg_frpm_pct, SUM("Charter School (Y/N)"=1) AS charter, SUM("Charter School (Y/N)"=0) AS non_charter, ROUND(AVG(sat),2) AS avg_sat FROM b
SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_provision2_schools FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet=1 AND f."NSLP Provision Status"='Provision 2' GROUP BY s.City

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name"='Los Angeles' AND f."School Type" IN ('High Schools (Public)','Continuation High Schools','High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)') AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)">500 ORDER BY s.School
